what: trial build: RGMII transmit with TXC from a 90-degree MMCM output (second global buffer, PHASESHIFT_MODE WAVEFORM), PHY TX delay off, RGMII v2.0 receiver set-up 1.0 ns and hold 1.0 ns (-max 1.0, -min -1.0; requirements 2 and -2 ns). Not adopted.
why_not_adopted: One TXC phase serves a whole port: port A's worst set-up and hold slacks sum to -31 ps (no phase closes it) and port B's window is 1 ps wide, narrower than the MMCM's 125 ps static phase step (VCO 1 GHz). Every pin's own sum is positive (+29 to +80 ps), so per-pin output delay trims could close it in principle, with margins too thin to rely on. The edge-aligned scheme in the design has per-port sums of -0.36 ns (results/b58a/build/summary.json).
